Inspirarás a un equipo orientado al detalle y la excelencia, creando experiencias memorables y contribuyendo al éxito de una reapertura llamada a marcar un nuevo hito en la historia de Gran Meliá Don Pepe . ¿Qué buscamos? Conocimientos en TTOO. Gran capacidad de comunicación y negociación. Perfil resolutivo y Orientación a resultados. Orientación al cliente y Capacidad analítica. Conocimiento de herramientas PMS Opera Cloud y Focus. Excelencia, proactividad y dinamismo. Atención al detalle. Alto nivel de inglés (C1-C2), muy valorable un segundo idioma (i.e. francés, alemán) En Meliá todos somos VIP En Meliá Hotels International apostamos por la igualdad de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres en el ámbito laboral, contando con el compromiso de la dirección y con los principios contenidos en las políticas de Recursos Humanos. Asimismo, nos importa la difusión entre toda la plantilla de una cultura empresarial comprometida con la igualdad efectiva, y la sensibilización de sobre la necesidad de actuar conjunta y globalmente. Impulsamos nuestro compromiso con la igualdad y la diversidad , evitando cualquier tipo de discriminación, especialmente, la relacionada con motivos de discapacidad, raza, religión, género o edad. Creemos que la diversidad y la inclusión entre nuestras personas trabajadoras es fundamental para nuestro éxito como compañía global . Además, apostamos por el crecimiento sostenible de nuestro sector a través de un gran equipo humano socialmente responsable. En este sentido, nuestro lema es “ Hacia un futuro sostenible, desde un presente responsable ” Gracias a todos/as los colaboradores/as lo hacemos posible. review_candidates.title: Global项目架构与集成工程师
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 作为Global项目的系统架构与集成工程师（韩国OEM方向），主导项目前期的技术评估和方案选项、自动驾驶系统的整体架构设计、软硬件集成与算法优化，并确保系统的高效交付。需要深入理解客户需求，协同跨职能团队（模块、产品、测试）完成技术方案落地，解决复杂系统级问题，提升产品竞争力与交付质量。 核心职责： Global项目解决方案主导与规划 负责头部及战略客户的售前技术工作全流程，从早期技术交流到最终方案定点。 深度洞察客户的业务痛点、长期技术路线图、系统架构与项目开发节奏。前瞻性识别技术风险、交付风险与量产风险，并制定缓解策略。 将复杂、模糊的客户需求，精准翻译并转化为公司内部产品、研发、交付团队可理解、可执行的解决方案蓝图。 作为公司在客户侧的技术接口人，直接与客户的CTO、智驾副总裁、系统架构负责人等高层进行高效沟通。 独立主持或各类技术评审会、方案研讨会、技术澄清会，展现专业权威。严格定义和把控技术承诺边界，对可能超出公司能力范围或严重影响项目利润、交付周期的需求，拥有否决权。 系统架构设计 根据客户需求设计自动驾驶系统整体软件架构，拆解为模块需求及系统基础功能（诊断、标定、升级、模式切换、数据回传、远程交互）、安全要求（功能安全、信息安全）等非功能需求，制定技术路线并驱动团队开发，最终确保量产交付。 主导系统软件设计，优化数据流、通信协议及模块交互逻辑，确保系统高可靠性与可扩展性。 软硬件集成交付 负责自动驾驶功能系统级交付，解决数据联通、软硬件兼容性及稳定性问题。 针对整车软件性能进行调优，联合模块优化产品体验，提升系统响应速度与资源利用率。 研发闭环与交付管理 掌握需求导入到实现、测试的过程工具，了解自动化构建、持续集成（CI/CD）测试工具链，提升研发效率与交付质量。 主导量产项目的全流程交付，协同内外部团队确保产品符合功能安全（如ISO 26262）及车规级标准。 基础要求： 能够韩语进行工作和日常沟通。 计算机、自动化、电子工程、车辆工程等相关专业，本科及以上学历（211/985院校优先）。 扎实的计算机理论基础，精通至少一门编程语言（如C++/Python），具备良好的代码规范与工程化能力。 深入参与过至少一个智能驾驶软件模块开发（感知、规划、定位等）或系统级工程化落地，具备复杂问题分析与解决能力。 AI探索和协作管理能力，有显著提高个人和团队效率的经验优先。 优先条件： 有自动驾驶系统架构或者集成经验，熟悉英伟达、高通等车载计算平台，或具备车规级软件交付经验。 熟悉功能安全标准（ISO 26262）、ASPICE流程或车载通信协议（如CAN/LIN/Ethernet）。 具备跨团队协作经验，能高效对接软件模块、产品及客户需求，推动技术问题闭环。 有量产车型软件交付背景，或嵌入式算法开发与集成经验者优先。 有L3/L4或舱驾一体量产经验者优先。 软性素质： 强烈的责任心和主动性，能主动识别技术风险并推动上游团队快速响应。 出色的技术沟通能力，擅长在复杂需求中提炼核心问题并制定解决方案。 对自动驾驶领域充满热情，能适应量产压力和快节奏研发环境，具备持续学习与技术迁移能力。 深度参与客户现场支持，需要经常去韩国出差。

review_candidates.description: Company Description ISEC (Integrated Services Engineering Consulting Company) is a Saudi Arabian engineering firm established in 2012, originating from CDE, which has provided multi-discipline engineering services since 1965. ISEC delivers engineering and consulting services across Architectural and Building Services, Urban Planning, GIS and Survey, Traffic and Transportation, and Power Transmission and Distribution, along with Project Management, Construction Supervision, and Manpower Supply services. Role Description The GIS Project Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Madinah, responsible for leading an enterprise GIS project from initiation to closure. The role covers planning, scheduling, resource coordination, client communication, and delivery of project management and technical deliverables in line with PMI standards. Key Responsibilities Prepare and maintain the project plan, WBS, schedule, and critical path. Lead the assessment, requirements gathering, and BRD activities with client departments. Manage resources, risks, issues, and stakeholder engagement. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports and present to steering committees. Oversee GIS system implementation, data management, and quality assurance. Act as the main point of contact with the client. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or higher in GIS, Geomatics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 10+ years of experience, including 5+ years managing GIS or IT projects. Proven previous experience as a Project Manager, leading projects end to end with direct client responsibility. PMP certification is preferred. Hands-on experience with Esri ArcGIS Enterprise and related platforms. Experience with Saudi government or semi-government GIS projects is a strong advantage. Fluency in English; Arabic is preferred. Strong communication, reporting, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Currently based in Saudi Arabia with a transferable iqama. Available to join immediately.

review_candidates.title: FM Central Administrator
review_candidates.description: North Bristol NHS Trust (NBT) and University Hospitals Bristol and Weston NHS Foundation Trust (UHBW) have merged as of 1st July 2026 to become Bristol NHS Foundation Trust. This creates an exciting future that brings together the best of both organisations. As a single, strong and sustainable organisation, we will not only be able to deliver better outcomes for our patients and fairer care for our population, but it will also provide greater opportunities for our people. Bristol NHS Foundation Trust recognise the value of a healthy work-life balance. When applying, speak to us about how we might be able to accommodate flexible working, so your work life fits around your home life. We particularly welcome applications from Black, Asian and minority ethnic candidates as they are under-represented within the Trust. Our job adverts may close as soon as sufficient applications have been received. Considering this, if you are interested in this role, please do apply as soon as you can. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) describes algorithms that can be used to produce new content, including audio, code, images, text, simulations, and videos. It is developing all the time and is now being used as a support mechanism for all kinds of content-based creations. Please note the use of AI is monitored and if applicants have used it then they are required to declare this. Job Overview This Position will be for the helpdesk function of the admin team. The main focus for the Helpdesk and Administration functions are: during the period on shift the post holder is responsible for the day-to-day operation of the Helpdesk to North Bristol NHS Trust, and it’s employees for all specialities within Facilities Management (Estate Management, Portering Services, Domestic Services, Catering, Laundry and Waste Management), ensuring a prompt and professional service at all times; log the faults/requests and close work orders once the work is completed; provide full administration support in all aspects of the administration and general running of the Facilities Department; process and monitor pay, annual leave and absence for circa 900 facilities staff. The role is to act as the first point of contact for all service requests that help to facilitate as far as possible, a comfortable, safe, and pleasant patient experience. Main duties of the job Our main role within admin is to support the rest of facilities in as many ways we can, by providing a central service which offers help in various tasks from absences to pay queries. Working for our organisation Bristol NHS Foundation Trust brings together more than 28,000 staff to deliver over 160 clinical services across thirteen hospital locations, operating from three main sites at Southmead, Bristol city centre and Weston. With an annual turnover of £2.3 billion, we are now one of the largest NHS trusts in the United Kingdom. Our hospitals are spread across Bristol and Weston, join us and you can enjoy the very best of both worlds; city living within a stone’s throw of the countryside or beside the seaside, both with easy access to all that the South West has to offer. Bristol NHS Foundation Trust values all people as individuals. As an equal opportunities employer actively working towards a diverse workforce we aim to recruit and retain a workforce which represents the rich diversity of the local population at all levels and are committed to designing our services around the needs of individual patients and those around them. Anonymous information will be used from your application in order to ensure we’re meeting our pledge. Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities For a more detailed job description and main responsibilities, please refer to the job description document attached to this vacancy. Person specification Work Experience Essential criteria Must have experience of dealing with people using the telephone. Excellent telephone manner Must have sound practical understanding of the need for efficient administrative support in an organisation Experience of data entry Desirable criteria Previous experience of working within a customer help line environment Knowledge/Skills/Abilities Essential criteria Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision Must be a team player, having good interpersonal skills, and be able to liaise, co-operate and work with a wide range of Trust staff members Must have good communication skills, both written and verbal and the ability to manage difficult or challenging telephone conversations effectively PC literate, experience of Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, Outlook etc.) Desirable criteria Knowledge of NHS Policies and Procedures We hope that you will decide to join us and become part of this exciting journey, helping us to shape our future together. As an equal opportunities employer actively working towards a diverse workforce we aim to recruit and retain a workforce which represents the rich diversity of the local population at all levels and are committed to designing our services around the needs of individual patients and those around them. Anonymous information will be used from your application to ensure we’re meeting our pledge. The Trust is committed to investing in and caring for all our staff. We will support you in maintaining and improving your health and wellbeing, as well as your career development through management and training support - developing exceptional people for exceptional careers. BFT is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people, and vulnerable adults. To comply with Part 7 of the Immigration Act 2016 all applicants must be able to speak fluent English to an appropriate standard which will be assessed at Interview. If you require sponsorship for a visa to work in the UK, to avoid disappointment, please check to ensure you are eligible under the UKVI points based system. The Trust uses electronic new starter forms on Trac to collect personal details. Information collected is securely stored and used to set up the employee record on the ESR HR system. By applying for this post, you are agreeing to Bristol NHS Foundation Trust transferring the information contained in this application to its preferred applicant management system. If you are offered a job, information will also be transferred into the national NHS Electronic Staff Records system. Please be aware of scams – unless specified above, we will only communicate with you via @recruit.trac.jobs or nhs.net e-mails and we will never ask you for any payments. Important Please note that if you apply for a position with this Trust, you may be contacted via Trac or via email. This includes invites for job interviews. We therefore recommend that you regularly check your Trac account and email accounts. We may also contact you by texting the mobile number, if provided, on the application form. Due to the high number of applications that are received for some posts we may close this vacancy before the advertised closing date. Therefore, please apply for this post as soon as you can, if you are interested and you meet the requirements of the Person Specification Only those candidates who clearly demonstrate how they meet the person specification will be shortlisted for this job. As a guide interviews should usually take place within 3 weeks of the closing date. When providing employment reference details, please provide correct work-related email addresses so references can be sought promptly when we are looking to progress your application. Your referee must all be known to you in a line manager or professional lead capacity.

review_candidates.title: CQE主管
review_candidates.company: 中山欧科电子有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职位概述 / Job Summary 负责客户质量管理体系的搭建与持续优化，带领CQE团队处理客户投诉、现场支持、批量退机问题及质量改进项目。通过专业的8D问题解决、跨部门协同与数据分析，提升客户满意度与产品可靠性。同时，推动AI与数字化工具在质量管理中的应用，实现智能化、可视化的质量闭环。 主要职责 / Key Responsibilities 1. 客户投诉处理与现场支持 / Customer Complaint Handling & On-Site Support -跟进客户投诉问题，及时输出8D报告，确保根因彻底分析与纠正措施落实； Follow up on customer complaints and issue complete 8D reports promptly, ensuring root cause analysis and effective corrective actions. -通过邮件、电话、微信等工具，快速响应重点客户质量投诉并反馈至相关部门； Respond promptly to key customer complaints through email, phone, or instant messaging and communicate issues to relevant departments. -负责SBOM、售后维修手册、客户技术支持文档等文件的编制与维护； Prepare and maintain technical documents such as SBOM, after-sales manuals, and customer support documentation. -主导市场批量退机（RMA）问题的分析、返工与验证处理，确保闭环与追溯； Lead analysis and rework for market-returned products (RMA), ensuring full traceability and problem closure. -必要时前往客户现场进行问题勘察、验证与处理，协调跨部门制定纠正与预防措施； Conduct on-site investigation and validation at customer locations, coordinating CAPA implementation with cross-functional teams. 2. 客户质量系统与流程优化 / Customer Quality System & Process Optimization -建立并维护客户质量管理体系，确保符合ISO9001 / IATF16949标准； Develop and maintain customer quality systems in compliance with ISO9001 / IATF16949. -主导客户审核、PPAP、APQP、FAI等质量文件的准备与应对； Lead customer audits and prepare PPAP, APQP, and FAI documentation. -推动质量流程标准化与系统化，确保NPI与变更管理的质量稳定性； Standardize and systemize quality processes to ensure stability in NPI and engineering changes. 3. 团队管理与能力提升 / Team Leadership & Capability Development -领导CQE团队，提升问题解决与客户沟通能力； Lead and develop the CQE team to enhance problem-solving and communication capabilities. -组织质量培训（8D、FMEA、SPC、MSA、DOE等），建立学习型质量团队； Conduct quality training (8D, FMEA, SPC, MSA, DOE) and build a learning-oriented team. -推动跨部门协作，与工程、制造、采购、售后等团队共同提升客户质量绩效； Promote cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Service teams to enhance customer quality performance. 4. 客户关系与战略支持 / Customer Relations & Strategic Support -维护重点客户质量关系，定期组织客户质量会议和数据评审； Maintain key customer relationships through regular quality reviews and data analysis meetings. -支持客户审核、新项目质量策划及样品验证，确保客户满意与信任； Support customer audits, new project quality planning, and sample validation to ensure customer trust. -代表公司处理客户质量议题，输出客户质量改善报告与分析； Represent the company on customer quality topics and provide improvement reports. 5. 数字化与智能质量管理 / Digital & AI-enabled Quality Management -建立质量数据分析体系（DPPM、FPY、RMA、Customer Complaint Rate等）； Develop and manage quality data systems including DPPM, FPY, RMA, and complaint rate. -应用AI与大数据技术进行质量趋势预测、异常检测与预警； Apply AI and big data analytics for trend prediction, anomaly detection, and quality alerts. -推动数字化质量工具（如QMS、MES、Power BI）集成，实现质量过程可视化与智能决策； Promote integration of digital quality tools (QMS, MES, Power BI) for real-time visibility and data-driven decision-making. 三、任职资格 / Qualifications -本科及以上学历，电子、机械、工业工程或质量管理相关专业； Bachelor’s degree or above in Electronics, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or Quality Management. -8年以上质量工程经验，3年以上客户质量或团队管理经验； Minimum 8 years in quality engineering, with at least 3 years in customer quality or leadership role. -熟悉8D、APQP、PPAP、FMEA、SPC、MSA等质量工具与方法； Proficient in 8D, APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, and MSA methodologies. -熟悉ISO9001 / IATF16949质量体系要求，具备客户审核经验； Familiar with ISO9001/IATF16949 quality systems with experience in customer audits. -熟悉AI应用、QMS系统或Power BI分析工具者优先； Experience with AI, digital QMS, or Power BI analytics preferred. -英语流利，具备客户沟通与报告呈现能力。 Fluent English in both written and spoken communication

review_candidates.title: Business Development Director, Institutional
review_candidates.description: About the Opportunity A well-established global asset manager — part of a larger, listed financial services group with a multi-decade track record and deep institutional roots — is building its Asia Pacific institutional distribution franchise from Singapore. This is the firm's first dedicated asset management hire in the region: a hands-on, frontline sales seat for someone who has already sold public markets investment products to institutional investors across APAC. You will have the backing of a global platform — investment, product, portfolio management, marketing, legal, compliance, and RFP support across the US and Europe — but in-region, you are building from the ground up. The APAC mandate is product-led, with a clear priority on long-only equity, factor-based, smart beta, systematic, and quantitative equity strategies . Liquid alternatives and credit-related strategies sit within the broader platform, but the core of this seat is opening institutional doors and converting mandates for listed / liquid asset management products. Singapore is the regional base. You will build the APAC client base starting from your own institutional relationships across Singapore, Korea, and the broader region. The Role This is a frontline institutional business development role — not a team-management seat, a regional figurehead position, or a relationship-maintenance desk. You will: Originate and close new institutional business across long-only equity, factor-based, smart beta, systematic, and quantitative equity strategies, and related listed / liquid asset management products Build relationships with sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurers, investment consultants, central banks, private banks, and other institutional allocators across APAC Lead the full sales cycle — from first engagement and investor education through due diligence, RFP / DDQ, and mandate award Represent the firm credibly with CIOs, investment teams, consultants, and institutional decision-makers Work with global product specialists, portfolio managers, marketing, legal, compliance, and RFP teams to support client conversations Provide market intelligence on APAC investor appetite, competitor positioning, pricing, and product demand You will report into senior asset management leadership overseas. You will have global support, but you will not inherit a local APAC book or a local sales team. The expectation is simple: operate independently, earn the trust of institutional investors, and turn relationships into measurable AUM growth. What Makes You a Fit You have likely spent 10–15 years in institutional asset management sales, business development, and relationship management — and you can point to mandates you personally originated and closed, not just relationships you maintained. You will probably recognise yourself in most of the following: You have sold public markets asset management products to institutional investors in APAC, and you can name the investor type, product, market, and AUM raised You have specific experience distributing long-only equity, factor-based, smart beta, systematic, or quantitative equity strategies Your recent coverage has been direct institutional — sovereign wealth funds, pensions, insurers, investment consultants, central banks, private banks — rather than retail or advisor / intermediary channels You can hold your own with a CIO, consultant, or investment committee on equity strategy positioning, factor exposures, portfolio construction, performance drivers, risk, and the due-diligence questions that follow You are a hunter who is comfortable building a market from scratch, without inherited accounts or a large local infrastructure You hold a degree in Economics, Business, Mathematics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field — a Master's or MBA is a plus You are based in Singapore, or can be quickly. Singapore Citizenship or Permanent Residency is preferred It would be an advantage if you also bring: Liquid alternatives distribution experience ETF, index, or smart beta distribution experience Korea, Japan, or broader North Asia institutional coverage US CLO or credit product distribution experience MAS Capital Markets Services Registered Representative status What Is On Offer A founding APAC institutional distribution seat within a global asset management platform A product-led mandate focused on listed / liquid investment strategies, with full global investment and product support The opportunity to build a regional franchise from Singapore and shape the firm's APAC presence from day one A performance-linked compensation structure designed to reward new business growth
